name: ClaimIDX
description: Local MCP server and CLI that indexes recurring software failures and replay-tested fixes, so coding agents can check prior art before retrying. Install with `pip install "claimidx[server]"` and launch `claimidx-mcp` over stdio. Capabilities to know about: it can run an eval command locally to replay a claim and can apply a pin or patch only with an explicit yes flag, and `claimidx run` executes a command you give it. Claims are stored locally; sharing a public projection to the commons at home.claimidx.com requires a per-claim confirmation (`--share-yes`) and `CLAIMIDX_COMMONS=0` disables it. The package and the public commons are free; ClaimIDX also sells optional hosted homes and a one-time $299 Private Home Pilot. The submitter is the project's author.
